name: Forever Yours
storyline:
You've called Aeternum your home for so long, but what is it to you really? A place where you eat, work, sleep, pray? Who are those who live on its grounds to you? Is your bright-eyed, fellow follower endearingly earnest or is she too naive for her own good? Is the serene and beautiful leader satisfying your deepest urges or overindulging in something more dangerous?

You've known this place for almost as long as you can remember, it runs in deep as you as the scar marring half of your being, and yet it's still so blurry. But you can make it clearer. You just have to follow Her to Forever.
summary: Forever Yours is a Mystery Horror Visual Novel made in a month for the 2025 Toxic Yuri Game Jam. Centering around a main cast of three women, and how Marcy navigates a growing unwellness they feel as they live out their life on Aeternum. Meet Sarah, a bubbly new member of the compound who seems to grow a quick liking to you. Navigate tricky conversations with the enigmatic Eleanor, Aeternum's beloved reverend.
